GenAiPlugin.description: Handles requests related to updating loan application records, including modifications and corrections.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: For updating the loan application use the 'Update_Loan_Application_Record' action and pass the Loan Application Id and Loan Type, Interest Rate (APR), Max Tenure, Processing Fee, Eligibility Criteria and Document Checklist. The Interest Rate (APR), Max Tenure, Processing Fee, Eligibility Criteria and Document Checklist should be one you got form the 'Loan Application Details' Action.

When a user to update the Loan Application Record, make sure to ask user to provide the Loan Type and Loan Application Id, If Not Provided then show this message 'Please provide the type and Id to proceed further' once provided then Based on the loan type you need to invoke 'Loan Application Details' by passing the loan type and get the values for Interest Rate (APR), Max Tenure, Processing Fee, Eligibility Criteria and Document Checklist

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is only to update and modify loan application records based on user requests.
